installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /mnt/server

# GLIBCXX_3.4.32 සඳහා අවශ්‍ය C++ Libraries Update කිරීම
echo "Installing GLIBCXX requirements..."
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y software-properties-common
add-apt-repository ppa:ubuntu-toolchain-r/test -y
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y libstdc++6 libstdc++-13-dev

ZIP_URL="https://github.com/mtarg/mtarg-linux-ubuntu-files/releases/download/v1.0.0/coremtarg.zip"

echo "========================================="
echo "Starting CoreMTARG Custom Server Setup..."
echo "========================================="

echo "[1/4] Downloading CoreMTARG package..."
curl -sSL -o coremptarg.zip "${ZIP_URL}"

echo "[2/4] Extracting core files & custom x64 modules..."
unzip -o coremptarg.zip
rm -f coremptarg.zip

echo "[3/4] Setting execution permissions for x64 binaries..."
if [ -d "x64" ]; then
    chmod -R +x x64
fi

if [ -f "mta-server64" ]; then
    chmod +x mta-server64
fi

echo "[4/4] Finalizing file permissions..."
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

echo "========================================="
echo "CoreMTARG Installation Completed Successfully!"
echo "========================================="
